program: Secure Configurable Linux Shell: Input/Output Redirection

results.test: Output redirection truncates and writes to a file
results.expected: output.txt contains alpha followed by a newline
results.actual: Secure Configurable Linux Shell | Input/output redirection: <, >, >> | Built-ins: cd, exit | io-shell> [process] shell PID 4702 started child PID 4703 | [process] child PID 4703 exited with status 0 | io-shell> Shell closed.

results.test: Append redirection preserves existing file content
results.expected: output.txt contains old and new on separate lines
results.actual: Secure Configurable Linux Shell | Input/output redirection: <, >, >> | Built-ins: cd, exit | io-shell> [process] shell PID 4704 started child PID 4705 | [process] child PID 4705 exited with status 0 | io-shell> Shell closed.

results.test: Input redirection supplies a file to standard input

results.test: Input and output redirection work in one command
